input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: Assignment is one-sided and falls into walk-away territory. Section (c) (p0149) imposes a blanket consent requirement on Licensee with no affiliate or M&A successor carve-out and no reasonableness standard, while imposing no restriction at all on Licensor's own assignment (so it fails even the mutual-notice fallback). Worse, Article XX (p0134) provides that this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses automatically terminate on a Licensee Change of Control (asset sale, merger or equity transfer) absent Licensor's officer-level written consent, with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing where the acquirer competes with Licensor or where Licensor merely "reasonably believes" its interests would be adversely affected — an effective vendor exit right on our corporate transactions. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out and a reasonable, mutual consent standard (plus a no-competitor limit on Licensor assignment) and removes the change-of-control termination trigger, replacing it with notice to Licensor.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Licensee, require Licensor consent for its own assignments, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made the consent standard mutual and reasonable. We also removed the automatic termination on our change of control, since our playbook does not permit a vendor exit or re-pricing right triggered by our corporate transactions; notice to Licensor is retained instead.

ops.oldText: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
ops.newText: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed; provided that Licensee may assign this Agreement in its entirety, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity, upon written notice to Licensor. Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) A Change of Control (as defined below) of Licensee shall not constitute an assignment of this Agreement, shall not require Licensor's consent, and shall not give Licensor any right to terminate, suspend, or re-price this Agreement or any of Licensee's rights or licenses hereunder. Licensee shall notify Licensor in writing of any Change of Control within thirty (30) days after its consummation.
